data.body:
Root cause CONFIRMED (rebar-debug Phase 1). The contradiction is real today, and the guide — not the criterion — is the out-of-sync artifact.

Authority chain (proven at runtime, not just read): `rebar explain G6` renders from the prompt library file src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_G6.md:9 via registry.explain_criterion() — verified by mutating that file and observing the sentinel appear in `rebar explain G6` output, then reverting. docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md is GENERATED from the registry and is a derivative, not an authority. `rebar explain plan` serves the packaged src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md via explain_guide(). Two independently-canonical artifacts, no generator or parity gate linking them — that is the mechanism.

G6's binding text: clause (3) the reviewer generates alternatives and DISCARDS them, 'never write them into the plan', 'the implementer's plan still contains only ONE approach'; clause (4) 'Confirm the plan states a POSITIVE rationale ... do NOT require a rejected-alternatives section (that primes implementers with rejected behavior)'.

Chronology proves the direction of drift: the anti-priming clause landed 2026-06-20 (criteria v6/v7/v8, commits 1ab70322c/63ba508aa) and shipped 2026-06-23 (2873a9164, 80d7b5b0d). The guide's rejected-alternative lines were added a month later by e1072a887 (2026-07-18) and repackaged unchanged by c2bfbe217. `git log -S 'primes implementers'` shows only additions — no commit ever removed or weakened the rule. So the guide contradicted a pre-existing, still-live contract; there was no deliberate supersession.

Considered and rejected the alternative readings: (a) 'G6 is the defect' — refuted, G6 is triply corroborated (prompt library, criteria_routing.json G6.positive_rationale checklist, and the Q8 design record at docs/experiments/plan-review-criteria-coverage-and-gaps.md:96-108 with DSO prior-art validation), and predates the guide; (b) 'reconcilable — the advice is sufficient-not-required' — refuted because G6 frames the harm as damage to the artifact ('primes implementers'), which occurs when the author writes it regardless of how the reviewer scores it, and because line 287 affirmatively misstated the gate by claiming the rejected alternative is 'what clears the blocking bar'.

Blast radius: confined to ONE file. Other packaged guides, AGENTS.md, docs/, templates and .rebar/ are clean. ADR occurrences of 'Rejected:' are a legitimately different use (an ADR is a design record, which is exactly where rejected alternatives belong per docs/adr/0055:301) and were left alone. The reviewer-side 'weigh alternatives' coaching move (guide line 227, mirroring coach_moves.MOVE_REGISTRY) is NOT in conflict — it asks the planner to do the weighing, not to persist the loser — and was deliberately left untouched.

No design judgement was required: the authoritative contract already names both what IS required (positive rationale) and what is NOT (a rejected-alternatives section).
